source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Internet of Things (IoT) (PDF 109-110, printed 105-106).

blocks.text: Internet of Things (IoT) physical devices ka aisa network hai jo internet se jure hon aur data jama, share aur us par amal kar sakein. In devices mein aam tor par sensors, processors aur communication hardware hota hai, jis se yeh mil kar samajhdari se kaam karte hain. IoT rozmarra cheezon, jaise lights, thermostats (darja hararat control karne wale aale) aur appliances ko jorta hai taake inhein door se dekha aur control kiya ja sake. Yeh aapas ka rabta rozmarra zindagi aur industry mein efficiency, sahulat aur foran (real-time) faisle behtar karta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: IoT fridge, gariyon aur lights jaise rozmarra devices ko jorta hai taake woh khud ba khud ek doosre se “baat” kar sakein.

IoT systems devices ko Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular networks jaisi wireless communication technologies se jorte hain. Har jura hua device doosre devices ya ek central platform se khud ba khud maloomat ka tabadla karta hai. Yeh musalsal rabta ek smart mahol banata hai jahan machines aur systems kam se kam insani mehnat se mil kar kaam karte hain.

Smart gharon mein IoT ke zariye log mobile apps ya awaz ki hidayat se lights, heating, parde aur security systems control karte hain (Figure 8.3). Maslan smart LED bulb smartphone se on/off ho sakte hain aur shaam 6:00 baje khud on hone ke liye set kiye ja sakte hain. Isi tarah smart parde subah ke alarm ke saath khud khul jate hain, aur jab kamre ka darja hararat 35°C se oopar jaye to band ho jate hain taake kamra thanda rahe. Smart thermostat user ki pasand ke mutabiq darja hararat badal sakta hai, aur security cameras seedha smartphone par alert bhejte hain. Yeh systems sirf aaram hi nahi dete, balke bijli (energy) bachate aur hifazat bhi barhate hain.

Sehat ke shobe mein IoT sensors mareez ki halat, jaise dil ki dharkan, blood pressure ya glucose (sugar) ki satah, foran (real time) dekh sakte hain. Is se doctors door baith kar mareez ki sehat dekh sakte aur emergency mein jaldi amal kar sakte hain. Isi tarah zaraat mein IoT devices zameen ki nami, darja hararat aur mausam ke patterns napte hain taake pani dene (irrigation) aur fasal ka intizam behtar ho, paidawar barhe aur zaya kam ho.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Smart ghar, pehne jane wale fitness bands aur smart farms sab IoT technology se chalte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen teen input sensors (darja hararat, harkat aur roshni) controller, ESP32 jaise microcontroller, ko data dete. Controller Internet ya cloud se data ka tabadla karta, jo mobile app aur daen teen output actuators: smart light, smart fan aur smart socket se jura. Note misali qawaid: shaam 6:00 baje lights, 35 C se oopar parde band, cameras phone par alert.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: IoT se smart ghar: lights, thermostat aur security systems ko internet se door se dekha aur control kiya ja sakta hai (kitab ki Figure 8.3 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sensors mehsoos karte, controller aur cloud faisla karte, aur actuators amal karte hain; phone app user ko nazar rakhne aur system badalne deti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: IoT ka matlab hai rozmarra cheezein (bulb, pankha, fridge, gari) jin mein sensor (mahol ko napne wala hissa) aur internet laga ho. Sensor data jama karta hai, internet us data ko aage bhejta hai, aur device khud kaam kar leta hai. Figure 8.3 mein baayein taraf sensors (input), beech mein microcontroller aur cloud, aur daayein taraf smart light, fan aur socket (output) hain.

blocks.prompt: Smart ghar mein IoT ki do misalein dein jo kitab ne batayi hain, aur sehat (healthcare) mein IoT ka aik istemal.
blocks.explanation: Smart LED bulb jo smartphone se on/off ho aur shaam 6:00 baje khud on ho jaye; smart parde jo alarm ke saath khulein aur 35°C se zyada garmi par band ho jayein (smart thermostat aur security camera alerts bhi). Sehat: sensors dil ki dharkan, blood pressure ya glucose foran (real time) dekh kar doctor ko batate hain.

items: IoT: internet se jure physical devices jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain.
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular se rabta; smart ghar, sehat aur zaraat mein istemal.
